# altr_dam_alert_rule (Resource)

Manages a DAM (Database Activity Monitoring) alert rule. Any change replaces the rule.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) ALTR Solutions, Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

resource "altr_dam_alert_rule" "example" {
  name              = "failed-query-alert"
  description       = "Alert on failed queries against monitored OLTP databases"
  severity          = "high"
  data_source_scope = "oltp"
  rule_type         = "match"
  email_recipients  = ["security@example.com"]

  filter_tree = jsonencode({
    op = "and"
    children = [
      {
        op           = "eq"
        dimension    = "query_status"
        string_value = "failed"
      },
      {
        op         = "in"
        dimension  = "statement_type"
        list_value = ["delete", "drop"]
      },
    ]
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `data_source_scope` (String) Data sources the rule applies to. One of `oltp`, `snowflake`.
- `name` (String) Name of the alert rule. Rule names are unique within an organization.
- `rule_type` (String) Type of the rule. One of `match`, `threshold`.
- `severity` (String) Severity of alerts raised by this rule. One of `low`, `medium`, `high`, `critical`.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the alert rule.
- `email_recipients` (Set of String) Email addresses that receive alerts raised by this rule.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the alert rule is enabled. Defaults to `true`.
- `filter_tree` (String) JSON-encoded filter tree that scopes the rule. Each node has `op`, `dimension`, and one of `string_value`, `list_value`, `number_value`, or `children`. Which operators are valid depends on the dimension; the API rejects bad combinations.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the alert rule, assigned by the API.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Copyright (c) ALTR Solutions, Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

# DAM alert rules can be imported using the rule ID assigned by the API
terraform import altr_dam_alert_rule.example rule-id
```
